narrative.overview: HouseholdApp is the shared surface a family glances at on the way past: everyone's stuff is on it, each person's things are recognisable by color at a glance, and nothing on it is precious. Structure is stock iOS; personality lives in the green tint, per-person color, SF Symbols, and soft tinted badges.
keyCharacteristics: Stock iOS structure; system text styles throughout, so Dynamic Type works.
Color = identity: one color per household member, purple for Everyone, a chosen color per category.
Soft tinted capsules for metadata (assignee, garden, trip, meal links).
Large circular check targets (44 pt) with a haptic on toggle.
Light, Dark, or System appearance, chosen per device in Settings.

rules.name: The Twelve Percent Rule
rules.body: A colored background is the color at 12% opacity (0.1–0.15 for emphasis panels), with the full-strength color on the glyph or text above it. Never a solid colored chip with white text, except a selected icon tile.

rules.name: The Red Means Late Rule
rules.body: Red text is reserved for overdue dates and overdue section headers, and destructive actions.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Use SwiftUI system colors, never raw hex, for anything except user-chosen category colors.

rules.name: The Text Style Rule
rules.body: Always system text styles, never fixed point sizes. The only fixed sizes allowed are decorative empty-state and celebration glyphs.

rules.name: The Platform Depth Rule
rules.body: If something needs to feel raised, present it as a sheet or put it in its own list section, never add a shadow.

dos: **Do** use stock SwiftUI containers (`List`, `Form`, `NavigationStack`, `.sheet`, `ContentUnavailableView`) before building anything custom.
**Do** give every person-related element its member color via `appSettings.memberColor(at:)`, and Everyone purple.
**Do** tint backgrounds at 12% with the full color on the glyph (The Twelve Percent Rule).
**Do** keep tap targets at 44×44 pt, add a haptic on toggles, and give rows a VoiceOver summary with `.accessibilityLabel`.
**Do** check Light and Dark appearance; the user can force either in Settings.
donts: **Don't** use fixed point sizes for text (`.caption2`, not `.system(size: 11)`).
**Don't** use raw hex for system roles; only user-chosen category colors are hex.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients, or custom navigation chrome.
**Don't** use red for anything except overdue and destructive states.
